abstention_rules: No hyperparameter, threshold, window, or gate change after the confirmatory run starts. Whatever the outcome -- including a clean H0 negative -- it is recorded honestly with the measured mechanism.
Pilot seeds {97021, 97022} were used ONLY for design calibration (G0 bit-identity check, TTC feasibility) and are never reused as tuning or test seeds.

Tuning is fully deterministic (coordinate descent, fixed order, strict-improvement adoption, ties keep incumbent, max 2 passes); the tuned dynamics are a deterministic function of the tuning seeds. No human selection among tuned candidates.
Arm E (endpoint reference) uses the DEFAULT dynamics and phase-0-only training; no attempt to make it competitive. If phase-0 rule == phase-1 rule, the Arm E reference is declared void (G4 -> null).

D.description: Fresh learner, DEFAULT dynamics, gains learn online from 1.0 on the target task. The fresh-learner control.

E.description: H0 reference arm: DEFAULT dynamics, FROZEN endpoint gains trained on the PRE-SHIFT world (phase-0-only source run, 5 episodes x 40 steps, default dynamics, same test seed). Reproduces the TRANSFER-K4-RESTORE mechanism on the shifted task: the frozen endpoint encodes the wrong world and cannot re-adapt.

X.description: Fresh learner, TRANSFERRED dynamics (tuned on the source task), gains learn online from 1.0 on the target task. Only the dynamics differ from arm D.

baselines: Arm D: fresh learner with default dynamics (the control).
Arm E: endpoint-gain transfer as the known-H0 reference (TRANSFER-K4-RESTORE mechanism).

decision_tree.then: BLOCKED -- implementation unfaithful; no transfer claims
UNINTERPRETABLE -- no distinct no-worse dynamics exist to transfer; the transfer question has no lever

decision_tree.if: >=2 test seeds uninformative (arm D never reaches criterion)
G2 PASS (>=3/4 informative seeds with >=30% speedup)
decision_tree.then: H1 SUPPORTED -- learning dynamics transfer: the adaptation PROCESS carries task-family knowledge
H0 -- learning dynamics do NOT transfer; report per-seed TTC table and the mechanism account (G3/G4 as labeled)

design.arms: D (default dynamics, control), X (transferred/tuned dynamics), E (H0 endpoint reference); all on the same target task, same test seed, gains always start at 1.0 except arm E (frozen phase-0 endpoint)

gates.G0_bit_identity: DynamicArbitrator(reward_baseline=0.5) is bit-identical to the parent WorkspaceTick path: 400-tick source run rewards exactly equal
gates.G1_tuning_sanity: tuned config differs from default in >=1 parameter AND tuning-seed mean total(tuned) >= mean total(default); else UNINTERPRETABLE
gates.G2_transfer: (TTC_D - TTC_X)/TTC_D >= 0.30 on >=3 of 4 test seeds, over seeds where D reaches criterion; >=2 uninformative seeds -> UNINTERPRETABLE
gates.G3_no_harm: arm X reaches criterion on >= as many seeds as arm D
gates.G4_H0_reference: (reported) TTC_E is None on >=3/4 seeds -- frozen pre-shift endpoint cannot re-adapt; void (null) if phase-0 rule == phase-1 rule

design.learning_dynamics_definition: The five adaptation hyperparameters governing the K4 gain-adaptation process: gain_lr (gain velocity), z_alpha (RunningZScoreBid decay), initial_var (z-score estimator init), gain_cap (gain ceiling), reward_baseline (delta-rule aspiration, owned by the arbitrator via DynamicArbitrator; the update still arrives ONLY through the broadcast feedback envelope). Tuned by deterministic coordinate descent on the SOURCE task (meta-learning); the tuned values are what is transferred.
design.metric: re-adaptation SPEED = time-to-criterion (TTC): first 1-indexed tick t with mean(rewards[t-40:t]) >= 0.75 over the 200-tick target run; None if never reached. Endpoint total reward is reported, NOT gated (H0 already closed the endpoint question).
design.source_task: Canonical changing_rule: 10 episodes x 40 steps = 400 ticks, phase 0 -> phase 1 flip mid-run, cue-indexed adapter (channels c0a0/c0a1/c1a0/c1a1), theta=0.45, capacity=3. K4 originals (tick.py, attention.py, consumers.py, broadcast.py, bids.py) NOT modified; new additive module prototypes/architecture-a/experiments/transfer_dynamics.py.
design.target_task: Post-flip changing_rule (shifted task): 5 throwaway resets advance the env episode_idx to 4; the 5 real episodes then run at episode_idx 5..9 = phase 1 throughout (the shifted rule from tick 0). 200 ticks. The loop starts with gains = 1.0 and must re-adapt to the new rule.

gates_summary: G0 fidelity (fail-closed) -> G1 tuning sanity -> G2 transfer (H1 iff >=30% faster on >=3/4 seeds) / G3 no-harm / G4 H0 reference
hypothesis: Learning DYNAMICS transfer where endpoint gains did not: a fresh K4 loop equipped with dynamics meta-learned on the source task re-adapts to the shifted (post-flip) task >=30% faster than a fresh learner with default dynamics, on >=3 of 4 fresh test seeds.
id_claim: EXP-FP-009x family (pre-allocated, Phase 7, transfer-dynamics lane) + exact ID EXP-FP-0090 claimed via experiments/id_registry.py before any write, 2026-10-07
null: Learning dynamics do not transfer: source-tuned dynamics re-adapt no faster than default dynamics on the shifted task ((TTC_D - TTC_X)/TTC_D < 0.30 on >=2/4 seeds), or the tuning finds no distinct no-worse dynamics at all (G1 fails -> UNINTERPRETABLE).

pilot.G0_result: PASS -- DynamicArbitrator(baseline=0.5) bit-identical to parent WorkspaceTick path, 400 ticks
pilot.criterion_feasibility: TTC_D = 43 (seed 97021), 40 (seed 97022) ticks -- criterion reachable well within the 200-tick budget
pilot.criterion_justification: 0.75 sits 25 points above the frozen-at-1.0 fixed policy (~0.5/tick) and 15 points below the ~0.9/tick noise ceiling
pilot.rule_shift: phase-0 rule [0,1] vs phase-1 rule [1,0] -- the shift is real and fixed across seeds (rules are pure functions of phase)
pilot.status: design calibration only; never reused as tuning or test seeds

receipt_target: flesh-pits/receipts/EXP-FP-0090.json, hash-chained via experiments/harness.py write_receipt (fail-closed on existing paths)

seeds.fresh_seed_justification: 97001-97003, 97011-97014, 97021-97022: seed-context grep over the flesh-pits tree finds zero prior use (2026-10-07); disjoint from all K-series, repro, and EXP-FP lanes

tuning_protocol.adopt_rule: candidate replaces incumbent only on STRICT improvement of tuning-seed mean total reward; ties keep the incumbent (parsimony toward default)
tuning_protocol.criterion: mean total reward over 3 tuning seeds on the source task (400 ticks, online learning from gains 1.0)
tuning_protocol.method: deterministic coordinate descent over PARAM_ORDER = [gain_lr, z_alpha, initial_var, gain_cap, reward_baseline]; a second pass runs only if the first pass adopted any change
tuning_protocol.stop: no change in a pass, or 2 passes exhausted

win_gate: H1 iff (TTC_D - TTC_X)/TTC_D >= 0.30 on >= 3/4 informative test seeds
